$$  0 < a \leq V_i(x) \leq b \,\,? \qquad (***) $$

$$ -\Delta u_i = 2 e^{u_i} \,\, \text{if }\,\, 1\leq r \leq 2. $$

   $$  u_i(0) \to + \infty, $$
